clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who keeps saying I'll start Monday - a nudge mixed with hope that ten minutes is enough to begin.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's encouragement is simple: if you're serious about making more money and building the life you want, it starts with feeding your mind — starting now, not someday.

You don't have to jump from zero to Elon Musk's one hour, five days a week. Start with one day a week for ten minutes. Lock the door. No phone. Just read.

Then build — two days, then three, then thirty minutes, then an hour. Consistency beats intensity every time.

No pings, no notifications, no distractions, no disruptions. That's the whole system.

What day this week will you lock the door for ten minutes?

#kevintrudeau #startsmall #consistencywins #selfdevelopment #richmindset #10minutehabit

clips.send: A friend shares this with someone who needs a morning mindset reset - awe at how one line from a billionaire sticks.
clips.caption:
Yesterday is history. Tomorrow is a mystery. Today is a gift — that's why it's called the present. One phrase, Kevin Trudeau says, can contain a whole book, like a seed contains a tree.

That's the idea behind his own book, Nuggets of Gold — one-line lessons you read in five minutes that stay with you all day.

Lesson 174 is just one word: persistence. Kevin Trudeau says J. Paul Getty and John D. Rockefeller both built their fortunes on the same line: persistence and determination alone are omnipotent.

Two of the richest men who ever lived agreed on one rule long before they had the money to prove it.

Which phrase would you want to read every morning?

#kevintrudeau #nuggetsofgold #rockefeller #persistence #selfmastery #dailywisdom

clips.send: A skeptic's friend sends this to someone who mocks manifesting - proof a NASA physicist took it seriously, sparking curiosity and awe.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau calls this book hard to find: The Science Behind the Secret, by Travis Taylor, a PhD physicist from Skinwalker Ranch who worked with NASA on classified aerial research.

The book lays out the actual physics behind manifesting and the law of attraction — written before quantum computers, before AI even existed.

Once you start reading it, Kevin says, you realize the science was describing reality decades before we had the tech to prove it.

If a NASA physicist takes manifesting seriously, maybe it's worth five minutes of yours.

#kevintrudeau #lawofattraction #manifestation #nasascientist #scienceofmanifesting #mindsetbooks
